title: Interoperability of Monitor Outputs Across Agent Frameworks

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Interoperability is important for ecosystem-level safety but is more of an engineering standardization problem than a core safety research question. Impact is practical but not deeply connected to alignment theory.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Mapping monitor output formats and building an adapter layer requires understanding multiple framework APIs and data formats. Moderate software engineering skill needed but no ML expertise.
